scope: DRY_RUN_NON_EVIDENTIARY ONLY. No production LOOK, no production ledger, no real forward Y, and the final maturity M is not used — the runner never consults it.

THE_QUALIFICATION_IS_THE_ORDER.principle: opening forward Y before the draw manifest is sealed must be IMPOSSIBLE, not merely unusual
THE_QUALIFICATION_IS_THE_ORDER.mechanism: open_forward_y() raises unless _y_gate_open, and _y_gate_open is set only by enable_forward_y_access(), which is step 9 of 9 and is itself order-gated
live_evidence: with SCALE/NULL maps already derived but the manifest UNSEALED -> still closed (6/9)
after DRAW_MANIFEST_SEALED but before the gate is enabled -> still closed (7/9)
succeeds only after the full nine-step order

DEFECT_FOUND_BY_THE_FIXTURES.defect: _require() appended the step BEFORE running the step's own validation, so a REFUSED step still advanced the state machine — a rejected derive_maps left the runner one step further along
DEFECT_FOUND_BY_THE_FIXTURES.how_it_surfaced: the seed fixtures reported step_order errors instead of seed errors: they were passing for the WRONG REASON
DEFECT_FOUND_BY_THE_FIXTURES.fix: split into _check (order only, no mutation) and _commit (after the step's validation succeeds)
DEFECT_FOUND_BY_THE_FIXTURES.consequence_verified: the seed fixtures now report the seed guards they claim to test
DEFECT_FOUND_BY_THE_FIXTURES.class: the same shape as the earlier fixture-passing-for-the-wrong-reason cases; caught, not counted

MAP_UNIVERSE.rule: time-local circular shift within (scope INTERSECT year-month INTERSECT session class)
MAP_UNIVERSE.worked_example: six months of 21 in-scope sessions -> 21^6 = 85,766,121 admissible maps
MAP_UNIVERSE.on_failure: BLOCKS the look — verified live with a 420-map universe; the budget is NOT shrunk to fit
MAP_UNIVERSE.early_close_handling: EARLY_CLOSE sessions take the identity map and contribute a factor of ONE, never zero — verified: a month of only early closes leaves the product at 21 rather than annihilating it

SEED_AUTHORITY.generator: PCG64 from a numpy SeedSequence spawned off the sealed master seed
verified: missing seed -> HARD FAIL, no regeneration
seed presented from the wrong authority -> seed_source
derivation deterministic: same seed, identical draw digests
no worker-local randomness — the module contains no urandom, no time seeding, no pid seeding, no unseeded default_rng()

LOOK_BINDING.requires: a verified chain with exactly ONE terminal LOOK
LOOK_BINDING.dry_run_LOOK_cannot_authorise_production: a PRODUCTION runner verifies the chain with expect_role=PRODUCTION, so a dry-run chain is rejected at the chain-role layer BEFORE any LOOK record is read
LOOK_BINDING.note: that refusal arrives as CHold from the ledger's verification layer rather than DHold — one layer earlier than D's own look_role guard, which is the stronger behaviour. The fixture names which hold actually fired.

ISOLATION.the_Y_that_was_opened: a synthetic token through the gate — the runner owns the gate, never the data

WHAT_THIS_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH: that the forward window, census or maps are correct for any real forward month — none exists
that the maturity M is settled — the runner never consults it, by design
STOP: settlement calls, forward evidence, forward Y and inference remain untouched.
